decision.explanation: Both awards are directly stated in the provided sources. Document d1 (D1S3–D1S4, D1S20) explicitly states that Knut Korsæth received the Commander of the Order of St. Olav, Norway’s highest honor, awarded by King Olav V. Document d2 (D2S2, D2S20) confirms that Korsæth also received the Commander of the Legion of Honour, a French award recognizing his contributions to Franco-Norwegian relations. These are distinct awards from separate countries, both supported by direct textual evidence.
